summary: Frontend testing of new Factory Map page (/factory-map) for QRU Factory Capability Consolidation. All 8 requested testcases PASSED: nav link 'Factory Map™' renders with data-testid nav-factory-map, page loads, Manufacturing Promise panel with all 5 pillar cards renders, registry-summary shows 91 capabilities (71 Active / 0 Inherited / 1 Deprecated / 9 Merged / 10 Future Backlog), tab-map shows flow rail + 12 layered map-node-* panels + 91 map-cap-* chips + map-destinations panel with QRU Store/YouTube/Podcast/Classroom/Enterprise/Future, clicking map-cap-little-legacy navigates to /little-legacy, tab-registry shows table with 91 cap-row-* rows and per-row cap-status-* chips + cap-select-* dropdowns, PATCH /api/capability-registry/{id}/status via dropdown succeeded with 'Status updated' toast, filter-all=91 filter-active=71 filter-merged=9 rows (correctly filtered — verified merged filter shows only Merged status rows).
critical_code_review_comments: FactoryMap.js (~200 lines) is clean and well-scoped. Handles loading state, error toasts, and dropdown status updates correctly.
Minor: map-cap-* buttons rely on onClick with disabled visual state via className opacity, but disabled attribute is properly set — good for a11y.

Nit: api.get/patch calls all silently swallow errors on load with .catch(() => {}) — if any of the 3 initial requests fail the page will show the infinite loader (map/summary null). Consider surfacing a load error state.
seed_data_creation: None. Status PATCH change was reverted to original value after verification.
